info.title: Medical Device Training — Learner API
info.description: Azure-hosted same-origin /api/v1 integration. Entra API access tokens are required except auth/config. The API owns progress, scores and model state. Model actions use HTTP 200 for accepted and rejected semantic outcomes. This document is generated with the application build; deployment and physical-device evidence are tracked separately.
